title: Minipurge:Orange
description: Add-on to Minipurge. Adds timed and announced loot drops to the game.
body:
Keep the action going with fresh supplies! **Minipurge: Orange** is an add-on for the [Minipurge](https://modrinth.com/datapack/minipurge) event framework. 

This data pack automatically triggers exciting loot drops throughout the arena as the game progresses. To make sure nobody misses out on the action, every drop is accompanied by a global chat announcement, alerting all players that gear is up for grabs! It adds a thrilling layer of unpredictability to your matches, turning random moments into high-stakes scrambles as players race to secure the dropped resources before their opponents do.

![Loot Drops](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1a88af0aa698a4440e80fd5ff70c0c395dcf2cb.png)

### ⚙️ How to Install

* Make sure you have the core **Minipurge** data pack installed in your world.
* Drop the **Minipurge:Orange** `.zip` file into your world's `datapacks` folder alongside it.
* That's it! Start your Minipurge event normally, and the data pack will handle the rest.

### 🛠️ Create Your Own Add-ons!

Minipurge is built to be a modular framework. Want to make your own custom events, loot tables, or structures? Check out the Developer Wiki on the main project page!
